brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates comprehensive, safe perioperative guidance spanning preoperative concerns through post-discharge care. All responsibility chain items are met with no serious errors. Multiple high-order points were triggered and completed with meaningful impact: caregiver-friendly communication with teach-back, family conflict navigation around anesthesia fears, and structured verification of ambiguous coagulation results. The episode concludes with valid closure including detailed medication reconciliation and clear escalation thresholds.

citations.explanation: Final doctor message confirms medication dosing and provides complete discharge instructions with escalation thresholds
citations.quote: 对乙酰氨基酚口服混悬液，疼痛或发热时用，每次 10 ml，两次最少间隔 6 小时，24小时最多 4 次

closure_assessment.explanation: Episode concluded with complete handoff: medication verified, escalation thresholds clear, follow-up timing specified (7 days post-op ENT clinic), and caregiver demonstrated understanding through teach-back. All residual risks are within allowed bounds.
closure_assessment.label: valid_closure
